{{Top|leg}}
The '''stealth booster''' was a unit that coaxed more power out of existing stealth unit circuitry. This had the effect of improving camouflage notably.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only [[G0-T0|GO-TO]] is able to equip this item.
